source_title: QUANTA SERVICES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Third Quarter Consolidated Revenues of $12.0 Billion*
Third Quarter GAAP Diluted EPS of $4.55* and Adjusted Diluted EPS of $6.06*
Net Income Attributable to Common Stock of $694.9 Million*
Cash Flow From Operations of $1.5 Billion* and Free Cash Flow of $1.2 Billion*
Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) of $41.8 Billion* and Total Backlog of $63.7 Billion*
Strong Performance Drives Significant Increase In 2026 Financial Expectations Across All Metrics
* = Record quarterly or record third quarter result
HOUSTON , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR ) today announced results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Revenues in the third quarter of 2026 were $12.01 billion compared to revenues of $7.63 billion in the third quarter of 2025, and net income attributable to common stock was $694.9 million, or $4.55 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2026 compared to net income attributable to common stock of $339.4 million, or $2.24 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock was $6.06 for the third quarter of 2026 compared to $3.33 for the third quarter of 2025.
"Quanta delivered another exceptional quarter, with third-quarter results that again exceeded expectations. Revenue, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted diluted earnings per share all achieved strong double-digit growth, cash flow was robust and total backlog reached a record $63.7 billion. These results demonstrate the power of our solutions-based operating model, as well as the execution certainty our self-perform capabilities deliver for customers every day. Given this outperformance and the expected incremental strength in the fourth quarter, we are again significantly increasing our full-year 2026 financial expectations across all metrics," said Duke Austin, President and Chief Executive Officer of Quanta Services.
"The breadth of our portfolio, combined with the fungibility of our skilled workforce across multiple end markets, provides a significant competitive advantage. This flexibility allows us to strategically deploy resources where demand is strongest, mitigate exposure to individual market cycles and deliver more consistent, predictable outcomes for our customers and stockholders. With demand for our services broadening across utility, power generation, industrial and technology customers, we are pacing ahead of the multi-year growth targets we outlined at our 2026 Investor Day, and our conviction in Quanta's ability to compound profitable growth over the long term continues to strengthen. We believe there is opportunity to deliver strong double-digit adjusted EPS growth in 2027, supported by continued backlog growth."
Certain items that impacted Quanta's results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 are reflected as adjustments in the calculation of Quanta's adjusted net income attributable to common stock, adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock and adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP financial measures). These items are described in the accompanying tables reconciling adjusted net income attributable to common stock, EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA to net income attributable to common stock and adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock. Quanta completed five acquisitions in the first nine months of 2026 and eight acquisitions during the full year 2025, and the results of the acquired businesses are included in Quanta's consolidated results from the respective acquisition dates. For further information on the items that impacted comparability of 2026 and 2025, see the footnotes in the accompanying tables presenting Supplemental Segment Data and reconciliations of EBITDA, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted net income attributable to common stock and adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock (non-GAAP financial measures) to their comparable GAAP financial measures.
Completed Two Acquisitions - In September and October 2026, Quanta completed two acquisitions that strengthen its front-end, fabrication and supply chain capabilities. The first is a Houston, Texas-based energy services provider with approximately 320 employees that offers engineering and design, fabrication, automation and controls, and engineering, procurement and construction services, and is included in the Underground and Infrastructure segment. The second is a Fort Worth, Texas-based vertically integrated manufacturer of steel monopoles and lighting structures, primarily for utility transmission and distribution applications, with approximately 270 employees, which will primarily be included in the Electric segment. Aggregate consideration, net of cash acquired, was approximately $245 million, consisting of approximately $96 million in cash paid or payable and approximately $149 million in Quanta common stock. The two newly announced acquisitions are not expected to contribute materially to Quanta's full-year 2026 financial results.
Enhanced Liquidity and Financial Flexibility - In August 2026, Quanta issued $2.00 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes. In July 2026, Quanta increased the aggregate revolving commitments under its senior credit facility from $2.80 billion to $2.98 billion and extended the maturity date for revolving loans from July 31, 2030 to July 31, 2031. Effective August 8, 2026, Quanta increased the maximum amount of its unsecured commercial paper program from $2.80 billion to $2.98 billion. On September 1, 2026, Quanta prepaid the full $618.8 million outstanding balance of the term loan under its senior credit facility.
Published 2025 Sustainability Report - In September 2026, Quanta published its 2025 Sustainability Report , which provides transparency around Quanta's sustainability strategy and the company's continued progress in 2025. Titled "Craft + Culture," the report highlights how Quanta's craft-skilled workforce and the investment in training, safety and leadership development behind it position the company to meet growing demand for reliable power, resilient infrastructure and modern energy systems.
Appointed Ellen Rubin to Board of Directors - In September 2026, Ellen Rubin joined Quanta's Board of Directors. Ms. Rubin currently serves as an Operating Partner at Glasswing Ventures LLC, a venture capital firm focused on AI and frontier technologies, and as a director of Allegion plc. She brings executive leadership and public company board experience, as well as deep technology expertise, including AI and cloud computing innovation, technology strategy and cybersecurity risk management.
RESULTS FOR THE NINE MONTHS ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 Revenues in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $29.45 billion compared to revenues of $20.64 billion in the nine months ended September 30, 2025, and net income attributable to common stock was $1.37 billion, or $8.97 per diluted share, in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to net income attributable to common stock of $712.9 million, or $4.72 per diluted share, in the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock was $12.98 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $7.59 for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
FULL-YEAR 2026 OUTLOOK Prior to the Company's conference call, management will post a summary of Quanta's updated 2026 guidance expectations with additional commentary in the "News and Events" and "Financial Info" areas of the Investor Relations section of Quanta's website at http://investors.quantaservices.com .
The long-term outlook for Quanta's business is positive. However, weather, regulatory, permitting, supply chain challenges and other factors affecting project timing and execution have impacted, and may impact in the future, Quanta's financial results. Additionally, we continue to consider future uncertainty associated with overall challenges to the domestic and global economy, including inflation, interest rates and potential recessionary economic conditions. Quanta's financial outlook for revenues, margins and earnings reflects management's effort to align these uncertainties with the backlog the Company is executing on and the opportunities expected to materialize during the remainder of 2026.
The following forward-looking statements are based on current expectations, and actual results may differ materially, as described below in Cautionary Statement About Forward-Looking Statements and Information . For the full year ending December 31, 2026, Quanta now expects revenues to range between $41.3 billion and $41.6 billion and net income attributable to common stock to range between $1.92 billion and $1.98 billion. Quanta also now expects diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $12.57 and $12.97 and adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $17.90 and $18.30. Quanta now expects EBITDA to range between $3.99 billion and $4.09 billion and adjusted EBITDA to range between $4.40 billion and $4.49 billion. Additionally, for the full year ending December 31, 2026, Quanta now expects net cash provided by operating activities to range between $3.45 billion and $4.00 billion and free cash flow (a non-GAAP financial measure) to range between $2.50 billion and $3.00 billion.
NON-GAAP FINANCIAL MEASURES The financial measures not prepared in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (GAAP) that are utilized in this press release are provided to enable investors, analysts and management to evaluate Quanta's performance excluding the effects of certain items that management believes impact the comparability of operating results between reporting periods. In addition, management believes these measures are useful in comparing Quanta's operating results with those of its competitors. These measures should be used in addition to, and not in lieu of, financial measures prepared in conformity with GAAP.
Please see the accompanying tables for reconciliations of the following non-GAAP financial measures for Quanta's current and historical results and full-year 2026 expectations (as applicable): adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock; adjusted net income attributable to common stock, EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA to net income attributable to common stock; free cash flow to net cash provided by operating activities; and backlog to remaining performance obligations.

This event will be facilitated through web-based audio using a Zoom Webinar. To register for and access the event, please log in to the webinar through the Investor Relations section of Quanta's website ( http://investors.quantaservices.com ). Please allow at least 15 minutes to register and download and install any necessary audio software. Additionally, Quanta has posted its Third Quarter 2026 Operational and Financial Commentary, as well as all other supplemental earnings call materials, in the Investor Relations section of the Quanta Services website. While management intends to make brief introductory remarks during the earnings call, the Operational and Financial Commentary is intended to largely replace management's prepared remarks, allowing additional time for questions from the institutional investment community. For more information, please contact Kip Rupp, Vice President - Investor Relations or Sean Eastman, Director - Investor Relations at Quanta Services, at 713-629-7600 or [email protected] .
FOLLOW QUANTA IR ON SOCIAL MEDIA Investors and others should note that while Quanta announces material financial information and makes other public disclosures of information regarding Quanta through U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings, press releases and public conference calls, it also utilizes social media to communicate this information. It is possible that the information Quanta posts on social media could be deemed material. Accordingly, Quanta encourages investors, the media and others interested in our company to follow Quanta, and review the information it posts, on the social media channels listed in the Investor Relations section of the Quanta Services website.
ABOUT QUANTA SERVICES Quanta Services is an industry leader in providing specialized infrastructure solutions to the utility, power generation, load center, communications, pipeline, and energy industries. Quanta's comprehensive services include designing, installing, repairing and maintaining energy, load center and communications infrastructure. With operations throughout the United States, Canada, Australia and select other international markets, Quanta has the manpower, resources and expertise to safely complete projects that are local, regional, national or international in scope. For more information, visit www.quantaservices.com .
